title: Expandable 4-wide AND-OR gates

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 5 (pin assignments and function tables)
TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 6 (gate and flip-flop data sheets)

pins.name: X
pins.text: expander input: connect to the X output of up to six 74H61 expanders; leave open if not used

functions.formula: Y = (A AND B) OR (C AND D AND E) OR (F AND G) OR (H AND I) OR X
functions.text: Y is high when AB, or CDE, or FG, or HI are all high, or an expander on X has all its inputs high (X = output of a 74H61).

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 25 pF, RL 280 ohm, expander pins open
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 25 pF, RL 280 ohm, expander pins open
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 25 pF, RL 280 ohm, C = 15 pF from GND to X
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 25 pF, RL 280 ohm, C = 15 pF from GND to X

electrical.notes: Designed for use with up to six 74H61 expanders. Expander current IX min -2.9, max -5.35 mA (SN74H52).

unknown: Maximum propagation delay with 15 pF on the expander node: the table gives typical values only.
notes: The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
